title: JNCASR Summer Research Fellowship Programme 2027
summary: Two-month research fellowship in a JNCASR lab in Bengaluru, across chemistry, physics, materials, engineering mechanics and life sciences.
eligibility: UG/PG students in science, engineering, technology, medicine or veterinary sciences (eligible years vary by discipline); 65%+ in Class X, XII and core subjects plus first class in recent semesters.

prize.description: ₹10,000 per month (₹20,000 total) plus second-sleeper train fare.

notes: 2026 window: 22 December 2025 to 31 January 2026, ₹500 fee. Expect similar dates for 2027.
